svg.aria-label: How I ship: 1 Plan, I design it. 2 Build, AI agents write the code. 3 Review, I check each change. 4 Test, automated suites. 5 Release, shipped and monitored. AI coding agents write much of the code; the architecture, the plan, the review rules, the tests and the release are mine.

svg.text: AI agents write much of the code. I own what ships.
Architecture, plan, review rules, tests and the release process stay with me.
